notes.title: Halloween 2018 Special: Some lovely games!
notes.notes:
Video games, you may have noticed, are often a little bit horrid. All sorts of naughtiness, and a distinct lack of people just being kind to one another. What are we like?! But fortunately there are games that make an exception to the potty-mouthed meanies that dominate, and today I celebrate them and their cuteness with a collection of lovely screenshots.

(more…)

notes.title: Free Weekend For Alphabear: Hardcover
notes.notes:
Whoa! We were able to make our award winning word game temporarily available for free. If you try it and love it, you can add it permanently to your collection for 50% off. It'll be up for just the next couple of days, so go grab it.

Also we recently did a tuning pass to address feedback from folks. The progression should feel super smooth. You can focus entirely on the important things in life: Spelling words and collecting cute bears. 

Enjoy!

notes.title: Patch Notes for 01.00.08
notes.notes:
- Bossy Bear and Crème Bearlée bears are back from vacation and can now be collected

- You can now share your Bearaphrases to Twitter directly from the game.

- We fixed an issue where keyboard users got blocked after finishing the last chapter. They may now continue to make words and befriend bears.

- We adjusted and cleaned up some word definitions

- The bear selection screen has been redesigned to provide you more information about the upcoming board

-Various other bugfixes and quality of life improvements
